How were SCRIPE passkeys, Sudo Mode, Account UX, and Quotas fixed?

Long image

A

Answer

Adopting polymorphic Fido2NetLib, cookie-backed 15m Sudo, mcp=true first-login, principal separation, and entitlement-gated quotas resolved every Track 1–4 and Milestone 9 failure.12

  1. Fido2NetLib replaces hand-rolled ECDSA crypto with array Transports, IDistributedCache ceremonies, encrypted string delete/rename IDs, and safe sole-passkey removal.123
  2. SudoService persists scripe_sudo_token across reloads via HttpOnly cookie, avoids empty-factor deadlocks, and ForceChangePasswordView updates tokens in one step.45
  3. Principal context separates PlatformAdmin from TenantUser, removes static club mocks, queues preferences against RowVersion races, and renders per-card skeletons.67
  4. Feature/quota plumbing uses real Edition and TenantFeatureOverride keys (ApiKey QuotaCounter), .IgnoreQueryFilters(), post-commit FeatureCache eviction, and zero-phantom UI gating.8

Applies toTracks 1–4 + Milestone 9Verified E2E

How do polymorphic Fido2NetLib passkeys and Unified Sudo connect?

Diagram structure
  • Account Persistent Shell ui_shell
  • Sudo Verification Modal sudo_modal
  • Principal Context Guard ctx_guard
  • Identity Controllers api_gate
  • Sudo Security Behavior astra_pipe
  • Fido2NetLib Service fido_svc
  • Distributed Challenge Cache chal_cache
  • Passkey Credential Table pk_store
  • ui_shell → sudo_modal · Step-up gate
  • ui_shell → ctx_guard · Scope tabs
  • ui_shell → api_gate · X-Sudo-Token
  • api_gate → astra_pipe · Validate policy
  • astra_pipe → fido_svc · Verify assertion
  • fido_svc → chal_cache · Consume nonce
  • fido_svc → pk_store · Load key

One Fido2NetLib service backed by IDistributedCache replaces custom WebAuthn parsing for both Platform Admins and Tenant Users.24

  1. Fido2NetLib Service ↗

    Parses ES256 DER, EdDSA, RS256, and hardware AAGUIDs cleanly across all authenticators.

  2. Passkey Credential Table ↗

    Stores keys for both PlatformAdmin and TenantUser principals with strict TenantId isolation.

  3. Sudo Security Behavior ↗

    Validates cryptographic 15-minute X-Sudo-Token values before allowing destructive Identity commands.

  4. Principal Context Guard ↗

    Shows Global Control Plane and Platform scopes to SuperAdmin while keeping /account/plan tenant-only.

2

How do first-login password change and Sudo step-up execute?

Diagram structure
  • User Browser user
  • Middleware & API guard
  • Fido2 & Cache fido
  • Multi-DB Store db
  • user → guard · Login returns JWT (mcp=true)
  • guard → user · Route to /change-password
  • user → guard · Submit New + Confirm Password
  • guard → db · Hash password, keep session
  • guard → user · Refresh JWT (mcp cleared)
  • user → guard · Delete passkey (no token)
  • guard → user · Require SudoVerificationModal
  • user → fido · Verify Passkey, TOTP, or password
  • fido → user · Issue 15m X-Sudo-Token
  • user → db · Delete encrypted passkey ID

Users on mcp=true finish password setup in one step, while sensitive mutations trigger adaptive Sudo step-up on demand.53

  1. Middleware & API ↗

    Blocks business endpoints on mcp=true except password completion, profile, refresh, and logout routes.

  2. Fido2 & Cache ↗

    Falls back from Passkey to TOTP 2FA or current password so accounts without hardware keys stay unblocked.

  3. Multi-DB Store ↗

    Decrypts string passkey IDs inside the handler and enforces the last-credential lockout guard before deletion.

How do the four implementation tracks sequence safely?

Diagram structure
  • Track 1 Auth track1
  • Track 2 Context track2
  • Track 3 Page UX track3
  • Track 4 Skeletons track4
  • track1 → track2
  • track2 → track3
  • track3 → track4

Each vertical track delivers testable backend, database, and UI scope while honoring SCRIPE CLI verification gates.38

  1. Track 1 Auth ↗

    Replace WebAuthn service, migrate polymorphic passkeys, unify Sudo step-up, and ship MMC-style first-login flow.

  2. Track 2 Context ↗

    Emit AccountPrincipalContext, swap branch picker for Control Plane badge, hide /account/plan for SuperAdmin.

  3. Track 3 Page UX ↗

    Rebuild Delegation, Break-Glass, PAT Console, Preferences sequential save, (i) popovers, and bilingual locales.

  4. Track 4 Skeletons ↗

    Keep Left Rail and Telemetry HUD mounted across navigation with exact-anatomy Nexus skeletons per card.
